data.name: Akbarah
data.gender_notes: Akbarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is exalted and great, possessing grandeur and magnificence. The name Akbarah carries the meaning “Great, Exalted, Grand” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Akbarah usually hope their child will grow to embody great, exalted, grand and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أكبرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من كبر أي عظم وارتفع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث يوحي بالعظمة والرفعة، مشتق من فعل كبر أي عظم وارتفع، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات بمعنى التعظيم لله تعالى، ويدل على شرف ورفعة المولود

in_urdu.name: اکبرہ
in_urdu.meaning: عظمت و رفعت کا प्रतीक، كبير سے ماخوذ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکبرہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عظمت و رفعت کا مطلب رکھتا ہے، یہ نام عربی मूल کا ہے اور كبير سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے بڑا یا عظیم، اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کا استعمال شرف و رفعت کے احساس کے ساتھ کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अकबराह
in_hindi.meaning: महानता और ऊंचाई का प्रतीक, बड़ा या महान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अकबराह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो महानता और ऊंचाई का प्रतीक है, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और 'कबीर' से मेल खाता है जिसका अर्थ है बड़ा या महान, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा के साथ किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: اکبره

In this sense, the name Akbarah can be seen as a source of inspiration and motivation for children to strive towards greatness in their personal and professional lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Akbarah can be seen as a reminder of the greatness and magnificence of Allah, the supreme Creator and Sustainer of all beings. The name can inspire contemplation and reverence for the infinite power and wisdom of Allah, and serve as a reminder of the ultimate goal of human existence, which is to serve and please Him. Additionally, the name may be understood as a reflection of the potential greatness that lies within every human soul, inspiring us to strive towards becoming the best versions of ourselves through obedience to Allah and His commandments.
